qualifier: ATF6/XBP1/CREB3 chaperone induction and ER-stress apoptosis control
name: ER unfolded protein response with chaperone induction and apoptosis
rationale: All members concern the ER-stress UPR (ATF6/IRE1-XBP1/PERK-ATF4 branches, stress translational control, ER-stress and beta-cell apoptosis); unlike confusables it is ER-specific, with ATF6/CREB3 chaperone induction, and lacks mitochondrial, HRI and GCN2 stress arms.

core: Short-chain acyl-CoA and small metabolite catabolism
name: Short-chain acyl-CoA, threonine, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members are mitochondrial catabolism of short/medium-chain acyl-CoAs, malonyl/succinyl-CoA, threonine/isoleucine, choline and carnitine synthesis; the choline, carnitine and threonine members separate it from confusables centred on BCAA/cobalamin beta-oxidation, alanine/gluconeogenesis or alpha-oxidation.

name: IL-12-driven T helper 1 cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IL-12 JAK-STAT signaling, Th1 differentiation, Th1 responses and cytokine production in CD4 T cells; confusables instead emphasise IL-12 and IFN-gamma production by dendritic and NKT cells or IFN-gamma response.

qualifier: late endosome, multivesicular body and autophagosome
name: Lysosomal fusion of late endosomes and autophagosomes
rationale: All four members are delivery to and fusion with the lysosome/vacuole; confusables concern autophagosome assembly regulation or Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis rather than the terminal fusion step.

name: Neddylation and cullin-RING ligase degradation of signaling proteins
rationale: Members share cullin-RING ubiquitin ligase activity and its neddylation/COP9 control, targeting NFE2L2, PD-L1, AURKA, DVL and NOTCH4; AURKA, DVL, NOTCH4 and K11/branched chain members distinguish it from PD-L1/tumor-immunity and RHOBTB confusables.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and its congenital enzyme defects
rationale: Members are glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis from pregnenolone and progesterone plus CYP11A1/17A1/21A2/11B1/11B2 deficiencies; confusables add sex-steroid (androgen/estrogen) synthesis or aldosterone secretion regulation.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Iron, heme, copper and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern uptake, transport, detoxification and homeostasis of iron/heme/transferrin, copper, cadmium, manganese and cobalt; confusables are zinc-centred, oxidative-stress (HMOX1) or general membrane transport.

qualifier: via sequestered calcium handling and membrane potential
name: Calcium handling regulating cardiac muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members share regulation of cardiomyocyte contraction/relaxation through calcium sequestration, release and membrane potential; confusables emphasise heart rate, negative regulation, ryanodine receptor or Na/Ca exchange.

qualifier: Treg differentiation, tolerance and Th1 restraint
name: Regulation of T cell activation, Treg differentiation and Th1 responses
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, proliferation, cytokine output and death alongside Treg differentiation, tolerance and Th1/Th17 commitment; confusables focus on peripheral tolerance/anergy, cytokine suppression, Th1 effector induction or NK cytotoxicity.

name: Golgi N-glycan processing and mucin-type O-glycan synthesis
rationale: Members cover N-glycan trimming and hybrid/complex elongation, GalNAc O-glycosylation (GALNT, C1GALT1C1 defects) and terminal sialyl/fucosyl/blood-group capping; confusables concern nucleotide-sugar precursor synthesis, sugar transport or sulfation.

name: RIG-I-like receptor-driven type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span cytosolic RNA sensing (RIG-I/MDA5), TBK1-IRF3/7 type I IFN induction and ISG/ISG15 restriction of viral replication; confusables add endosomal TLR7/8/9, cGAS-STING, type III or IFN-gamma responses.

name: Opsin phototransduction cascade and cone opsin defects
rationale: Members are opsin light absorption and activation/inactivation of the phototransduction cascade including OPN1SW/MW/LW and SLC24A1 defects; confusables are retinoid cycle or photoreceptor development.

qualifier: JNK/p38 MAPK and canonical NF-kappaB activation
name: TAK1-mediated NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 activation downstream of TLRs
rationale: Members are IRAK/TRAF6/TRIF/RIP1 signaling to TAK1 and IKK with JNK, p38 and canonical NF-kappaB outputs; JNK/p38 and stress kinase members distinguish it from confusables on noncanonical NF-kappaB, TNFR1, TLR3-IRF3 or cytokine production.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven permeability
rationale: All three members concern endothelial eNOS localization (NOSIP, NOSTRIN) and VEGFR2-mediated permeability; confusables cover NO-cGMP signaling or vascular smooth muscle tone.

qualifier: Leloir pathway, xylulose-5-phosphate and non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt
name: Galactose, pentose and xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism and enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose catabolism, glucuronate/xylulose-5-phosphate and non-oxidative pentose phosphate metabolism with their inborn defects; confusables add fructose and alditol/glycerol metabolism instead.

qualifier: pri/pre-miRNA processing, miRNA decay and target-specific translation
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA processing and degradation and miRNA control of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1); confusables cover core RISC/siRNA biogenesis, mRNA decay or miRNA transcription.

name: Purine nucleotide biosynthesis by de novo and salvage routes
rationale: Members are PRPP synthesis, de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis and purine salvage with HPRT1/APRT defects; confusables concern purine catabolism, pyrimidine synthesis or deoxynucleotides.

name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4
rationale: Members share proteolytic release of receptor intracellular domains for NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4; confusables are NOTCH1 signaling and Notch target transcription.

qualifier: taste modalities and class C taste receptors
name: Chemosensory perception of taste modalities and smell
rationale: Members are perception of sweet, bitter, umami, salty and sour taste plus smell; the multiple taste modalities and class C receptors distinguish it from olfactory-receptor or sour/pH-channel confusables.

name: Regulation of TBK1-IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic sensor (RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS) signaling through TBK1/IKKe to IRF3 and IFN-alpha/beta production; confusables add broader antiviral effector, NF-kappaB, chemokine and virus-specific modules.

qualifier: presynaptic choline uptake and acetylcholine release
name: Presynaptic acetylcholine synthesis and release via choline uptake
rationale: Members concern SLC5A7 choline uptake, acetylcholine metabolism and secretion and neuromuscular cholinergic transmission (bile acid transport is an outlier); confusables cover other SLC transporters, nicotinic receptors or NMJ assembly.

name: Mucosal innate antibacterial defense by agglutination and cytolysis
rationale: All three members are direct innate mucosal action against microbes (bacterial agglutination, cytolysis); confusables center on antimicrobial peptides, neutrophil killing or metal sequestration.

qualifier: kinesin/Miro transport and ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin- and Miro-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network
rationale: Members are microtubule motor transport of mitochondria and vesicles in neurons (kinesins, RHOT1/2) and ER tubular network formation; confusables cover microtubule severing, ER contact-site tethering or tubulin modification.

name: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
rationale: Members concern myosin/thin filament and myofibril assembly, actin-myosin sliding, contraction and stretch sensing within muscle fiber differentiation; confusables are myoblast proliferation/regeneration or NMJ formation.

qualifier: SMDT1 processing and mitochondrial calcium uptake
name: Mitochondrial presequence processing, protein degradation and calcium uptake
rationale: Members share mitochondrial protein processing/proteolysis, including SMDT1 maturation tied to mitochondrial calcium import; confusables cover protein import, cristae formation or respiratory chain assembly.
